subject: Money
title: The Panama Papers
description: A quick win: understand The Panama Papers.

hook.text: In 2016, 11.5 million leaked documents exposed how the world's elite hid trillions in shell companies.

buildup.text: Law firm Mossack Fonseca created offshore entities for politicians, athletes, and billionaires worldwide.

discovery.text: The leak revealed 214,000 shell companies in 21 tax havens. Leaders from 50 countries were implicated.

twist.text: Iceland's prime minister resigned within days. Most others faced no consequences at all.

climax.text: The Panama Papers proved what everyone suspected: the rich play by different rules.

punchline.text: Secrecy is a privilege you buy.

quiz.question: What did the Panama Papers reveal?
